items.title: Chevron, Exxon and Other Oil Stocks Jump as Two Huge Energy Stories Collide
items.summary: Iran and Venezuela just handed energy investors two completely opposite catalysts at the same time, and Chevron, Exxon, and Halliburton are reacting in real time as traders try to figure out which story actually matters for their portfolios.

items.title: Boeing, Deere and US Steel navigate labor union contract negotiations
items.summary: The aerospace maker plans to resume contractual talks after Labor Day. Meanwhile, U.S. Steel and Cleveland-Cliffs agreed to extend their steelworker contracts by 30 days.

items.title: Why Deere Stock Rallied Today
items.summary: The agricultural equipment maker's profits are set to soar.

items.title: Deere (DE): Baird Sees Upside as Agricultural Recovery Approaches
items.summary: On August 31, Baird upgraded Deere & Company (NYSE:DE) to Outperform from Neutral and raised its price target to $800 from $640, implying meaningful upside from the share price cited in the report. The upgrade is based on an expected improvement in North American agricultural fundamentals in 2027. Baird expects mid-2027 corn futures to move […]

items.title: Why Deere (DE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of agricultural and construction machinery company Deere (NYSE:DE) jumped 3.1% in the afternoon session after Baird analyst Mircea Dobre upgraded the stock from a Neutral rating to Outperform.

items.title: Deere and AGCO Rally 4% as Baird Upgrades Both on North America Row Crop Demand
items.summary: Baird just handed two farm equipment stocks a rare double upgrade on the same morning, but the reasoning behind each call points to a very different bet on how the ag cycle turns.

items.title: How Deere Stock Can Hit $800. A Farming Recovery Is Coming.
items.summary: FEATURE  It’s time to double down on the farm, Midwestern broker Baird says. A recovery is coming in 2027 that will benefit farmers, as well as shares of Deere AGCO CNH Industrial, and CNH dealer Titan Machinery  Baird analyst Mig Dobre upgraded all four stocks to Buy from Hold on Monday.
